# Verification log — Chrome checks run by Claude

Claude runs each `C-` check against the running app (`npm run dev` in `site/`, project `spec-test-b2c-telecom`) using the Chrome DevTools connector: navigate, snapshot, click/fill, screenshots, console and network inspection, accessibility snapshot, Lighthouse and responsive resizing. Results: `PASS`, `FAIL (note)` or `NOT RUN`. Developers write the checks; they never set results.

Evidence (screenshots, traces) is kept under `plan/evidence/<check-id>/` only when a check fails or needs a visual record.
